hypothesis: A fixed rule combining widening spreads, declining depth, and falling open interest can exercise pre-drawdown alert evaluation on scripted synthetic scenarios. This is an engineering hypothesis only.

research.acceptance_criteria: Accept engineering behavior only if fixture hashes match, future changes leave prior decisions unchanged, next-open fills reconcile costs, and incomplete outcomes remain unknown. No performance threshold selects this example.
research.limitations: Scripted public fixtures are not markets or a genuinely blind holdout. No fill probability, impact, funding, borrow, venue, or predictive validity is modeled. Always-long and always-cash controls are illustrative.
research.prior_work: Initial standalone example; no private code, market data, or outside research results used.

title: Synthetic liquidity deterioration and deleveraging mechanics
